verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server lets you generate dedicated API credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret) and rotate the secret. It also supports an OAuth2 authorization code flow that issues short-lived access tokens to act on behalf of individual users, which narrows an agent's identity and lifetime. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit permission scopes, read-only or per-endpoint restrictions, or agent-specific least-privilege controls. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or granular permission sets, read-only/limited-access credential options, agent-specific credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
